why: Calibrated on ubuntu, because that is where the gate runs. Coverage is platform-dependent: src/commands/tray.js has win32-only branches that execute on Windows and not on Linux, so a local Windows run reads about a point HIGHER (81.8 line vs 80.7). The first version of this file was set from a Windows measurement and failed CI on the platform it was meant to guard. Measured 80.70 / 73.23 / 86.01; floors sit just under. Raise with --update on a Linux run; never lower quietly.
